_comment: V2 Phase 1B (BL-020, docs/v2/10-BACKLOG.md). subject_types/object_types for the 9 live-used predicates are the exact type pairs observed in data/relationships/ (2026-08-14, all 204 live records), not guessed -- a predicate may show more than one valid pair (e.g. 'owns' spans brand/breeding_program/company/patent objects). 'distributes' (in the core schema's enum, 0 live uses) and the six accepted extensions have no live data to check against; their type pairs are inferred from predicate semantics and docs/v2/03-DOMAIN-MODEL.md, marked accordingly. evidence_required is true for every predicate -- this mirrors what schemas/relationship.schema.json already enforces structurally (evidence_ids, minItems 1) for every relationship regardless of predicate, so this field is a documented restatement, not a new constraint.

relationship_predicates.label: Distributes
relationship_predicates._comment: Part of the original 10-value V1 enum; not observed in any live relationship. Type pair inferred from 'carries' (the closest live-used analog) since no real usage exists to check against.

relationship_predicates.label: Exhibits Claimed Trait
relationship_predicates._comment: Not yet used in any live relationship record. Trait claims are currently expressed only in fact.statement prose and the trait entity's own evidence_ids/fact_ids -- not as a structured relationship (docs/v2/03-DOMAIN-MODEL.md, Relationship section's noted gap). This predicate exists to close that gap once relationships are actually authored this way; declaring it here does not itself create any such relationship.

relationship_predicates.label: Markets
relationship_predicates._comment: Distinguishes an owner/marketer's own promotional activity from 'sells' (a commercial transaction relationship).

relationship_predicates.label: Offers
relationship_predicates._comment: docs/v2/03-DOMAIN-MODEL.md describes the subject as 'nursery'; nursery is a role (taxonomies/entity-role-vocabulary.json), not a distinct entity_type, so the subject type here is 'company' -- a company entity carrying the nursery role, same pattern as every other role-qualified relationship in this pack.

relationship_predicates.label: Administers License For
relationship_predicates._comment: Distinguishes a third party administering someone else's licence program from 'licenses' (a genetics owner licensing its own variety) -- docs/v2/03-DOMAIN-MODEL.md flags this as the commercially most significant of the six new predicates.

relationship_predicates.label: Subsidiary Of
relationship_predicates._comment: Distinguishes true corporate ownership structure from the more general 'owns' or 'partners_with'.

relationship_predicates.label: Part Of
relationship_predicates._comment: Geographic Intelligence Resolution V1 (2026-09-01). The only predicate expressing true geographic containment (subject Geography contained within object Geography, e.g. Spain part_of Europe) -- distinct from 'operates_in' (company presence in a geography) and from any commercial-reach predicate. Authored once by scripts/generate_geography_containment.py from the UN M49 standard as a deterministic bootstrap; see app/services/geography_hierarchy.py, the sole runtime reader.
